Enum Class PatchShape

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PatchShape>
be.kdg.programming.integrationproject.model.Enums.PatchShape
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PatchShape>, Constable
public enum PatchShape extends Enum<PatchShape>
Houses structural, multi-dimensional boolean grid maps defining target dimensions for tile patterns. Crucial for matrix intersection placement verification tasks.
